title: U-NIAH: Unified RAG and LLM Evaluation for Long Context Needle-In-A-Haystack
authors: Yunfan Gao; Yun Xiong; Wenlong Wu; Zijing Huang; Bohan Li; Haofen Wang
why_relevant: Introduces a unified NIAH-based benchmark evaluating RAG vs long-context LLMs under retrieval noise, chunk ordering, and distractors, identifying error patterns like omission, hallucination, and self-doubt relevant to robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on long-context NIAH evaluation rather than proposing robustness methods.
